steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility

steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our interactive sessions cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, risk management, stakeholder communication, and exam strategy. You'll learn from active certified practitioners and earn the required contact hours entirely online—attending on your schedule while preparing for exam day.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your formal application to PMI with required documentation of education and experience. Pay the associated exam fee through PMI's online portal. Processing typically takes one to two weeks; you'll receive confirmation and your exam authorization before scheduling your test.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and Q&A sessions—to build confidence and solidify your knowledge. The PMP® exam tests your mastery of project-management practices and your ability to apply them in real-world scenarios. Schedule your exam at an authorized testing center and complete this final step toward your credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential remains valid for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or on-the-job project leadership. Stay current with PMI's standards and maintain your competitive edge in Plano's professional landscape by renewing before your cycle expires.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
